decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-d4ddf21e4b56] and the linked PR [ev-5d457de1d343] describe the change: Argo CD adds Azure workload identity as a new authentication method for Azure-hosted Git and OCI repositories. The PR describes it as something the operator enables ("enabling this feature will remove the credential management overhead"). [ev-a10ab54684db] shows it is configured through the repo / repocreds add CLI commands and the declarative repository setup (argocd-repositories.yaml, declarative-setup.md). That is enough to write the open applicability aspect: only environments whose repository credentials opt in to workload identity are affected, so existing environments are not exposed and the consequence is none. Confidence is low because the exact configuration key is not shown, and the opt-in reading comes from the PR's wording rather than a direct statement.
